# `assets/import/StlImporter.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/import/StlImporter.js`

engine/assets/import/StlImporter.js — STL (binary + ASCII) → EngineModel.  STL is CAD/printable part geometry: triangles only, no materials, no hierarchy, no declared units. We import geometry faithfully and leave the unit guess to the OrientationResolver / editor. Output is a single non-indexed primitive with per-vertex positions and face normals.

## Functions

### `importStl(data, opts = {})`

Import STL bytes or text into an EngineModel.
